line.s1_intro.text: Fox and Squirrel found two apples in the orchard.

line.s1_sq_small.text: And mine is small. But it's sweet!

line.s1_compare.text: The big apple is bigger than the small one. And the small apple is smaller than the big one.

line.s1_daily.text: It's the same at home. Mum has big shoes and you have small ones. Your shoes are smaller.

line.s2_thirsty.text: I'm thirsty! Which cup is for me?

line.s2_fox_asks.text: Squirrel has little paws. Can you help her choose?

line.s2_wrong.text: That is the bigger cup. Look for the smaller one.

line.s2_thanks.text: Thank you! The small cup fits my paws.

line.s2_summary.text: The small cup is smaller and the big cup is bigger. Great!

line.p_intro.text: Now a game. I'll show you two things and you choose.

line.p_click_biggest.text: There are three. Tap the biggest.

line.p_click_smallest.text: There are three. Tap the smallest.

line.a_intro.text: Bigger and smaller things are everywhere, not only in the game.

line.a_fox_idea.text: Find a spoon at home that is bigger than your hand.

line.a_sq_idea.text: And then something smaller than your thumb!

card.a_parents:
For the parent:
Line up the whole family's shoes from the smallest to the biggest.
Ask: which ones are bigger than yours? Which are the smallest?

line.a_bye.text: See you in the next lesson!
